text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about pedestrian safety on their roadway. Our office has received a petition from residents with overwhelming support for the installation of all-way stop controls at the above mentioned intersection. I am requesting that all-way stop controls be installed at Amsterdam Ave and Westview Blvd.
Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Amsterdam Avenue and Westview Boulevard.
